blocks.text: **CVE-2026-10520 - Ivanti Sentry OS command injection (CVSS 10).** An OS Command Injection vulnerability in Ivanti Sentry before the R10.5.2, R10.6.2 and R10.7.1 versions allows a remote unauthenticated user to achieve root-level remote code execution Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): standalone sentry 10.5.2, standalone sentry 10.6.2. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-20253 - Splunk Enterprise missing authentication (CVSS 9.8).** In Splunk Enterprise 10.2 versions below 10.2.4 and 10 versions below 10.0.7, an unauthenticated user could create or truncate arbitrary files through a PostgreSQL sidecar service endpoint. Fixed version (first unaffected release per NVD ranges): splunk 10.0.7, splunk 10.2.4. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.

**CVE-2026-35273 - Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools missing authentication (CVSS 9.8).** Vulnerability in the PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools product of Oracle PeopleSoft (component: Updates Environment Management). Supported versions that are affected are 8.61 and 8.62. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools. Fixed package release: not mapped in NVD ranges; 1 vendor patch or advisory reference available. Attack path: network-accessible; no authentication required; no user interaction required.
KEV additions by week: week of Jun 1: 5; week of Jun 8: 7; week of Jun 15: 4; week of Jun 22: 6; week of Jun 29: 1.
Known ransomware use (CISA): CVE-2026-50751 (Check Point Security Gateway), CVE-2026-35273 (Oracle PeopleSoft Enterprise PeopleTools) and CVE-2026-12569 (PTC Windchill and FlexPLM).
No campaign-specific IP addresses, hashes or domains are collected by ThreatWatch's automated feeds. Victim counts and campaign scope are not established unless cited in section 5.

**Defensive hunting focus:** unexpected child processes and outbound connections (8 CVEs); unauthorized administrative access and configuration changes (7 CVEs); unusual requests and changes (4 CVEs).
